# Draft:My Talking Tom Friends

----
My Talking Tom Friends is a virtual pet game developed and published by Outfit7 Limited on June 11, 2020.
Gameplay
The game allows the user to do various things with charaters.
Reception
The game received 13 million downloads and was one of the most downloaded games in July 2020.
In 2024, the game was featured in the United Nations Environment Programme's Green Game Jam, which allowed seeds and fertilizers to grow plants.
